svg.title: T for T-Shirt and Apparel Design
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. A serif T inspired by the original typography poster morphs into a black T-shirt with a collar, seams and a graphic print. The shirt moves left, then the T-shirt and apparel design heading and examples of tees, apparel and printed artwork appear.
svg.metadata: 1920 by 1080; 16:9; 6.5-second loop. T, ruler accents and mustard, black, cream and red palette adapted from 20_T_typography.png. Illustrative apparel concepts. All graphics, animation and type are embedded.
